description: myTarget (VK / Mail.ru) advertising SDK — interstitial, rewarded and banner (MyTargetView) ads

methods.name: initSdk
methods.note: Global SDK init. Sets the internal AtomicBoolean; once stubbed isSdkInitialized() naturally stays false. No init callback here, so no init-callback hang.

methods.name: load
methods.note: Parent of InterstitialAd and RewardedAd — stubbing here neutralizes both. Load is listener-driven (InterstitialAdListener/RewardedAdListener onLoad/onNoAd); stubbing load to void means neither callback fires. HANG RISK if the app blocks UI on onNoAd/onLoad; typical games proceed regardless.

methods.name: load
methods.note: Banner load. Listener-driven (MyTargetViewListener onLoad/onNoAd) — same no-callback hang caveat as interstitial.

manifest_components.note: Auto-init ContentProvider (5.13+). Disabling prevents zero-touch SDK startup. Authority is ${applicationId}.mytargetcontentprovider, so no collision with app providers.

protected_patterns.reason: Returns a boolean that is naturally false once initSdk is stubbed; leave it so callers correctly see the SDK as not initialised rather than being forced true.
Returns the MyTargetConfig object the app reads/configures; null would NPE.
BaseAd/MyTargetView getCustomParams() returns the @NonNull CustomParams the app configures before load; null would NPE.
Ad object getListener() returns the listener the app registered; leave the getter intact (it is a callback bridge, not an ad-serving call).
